---
title: "Pre-analysis plan"
# The date as the plan's title page writes it, 14 November 2026, where
# Quarto's default printed 2026-11-14 (owner preview of 48b585e).
date: today
date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-location: left
    embed-resources: true
    theme: [cosmo, report.scss]
    code-fold: true
    # Equations as MathML: no script, so an offline report shows them (8b-R).
    html-math-method: mathml
    grid:
      sidebar-width: 280px
      body-width: 900px
      margin-width: 160px
  docx:
    reference-doc: apa-reference.docx
    toc: true
  odt:
    reference-doc: apa-reference.odt
    toc: true
  pdf:
    toc: true
    # Tables single-spaced in a smaller size, as APA 7 allows, so that 10
    # columns fit the text width (Codex P1-05).
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{etoolbox}
        \AtBeginEnvironment{longtable}{\footnotesize\setlength{\tabcolsep}{4pt}\ifdefined\setstretch\setstretch{1}\fi}
        % A new page when less than #1 is left on this one, so a table's
        % number and title stay with it (the needspace package's test,
        % written out so no extra package is needed).
        \newcommand{\sfneedspace}[1]{\par\penalty-100\begingroup\dimen0=#1\relax\dimen2=\pagegoal\advance\dimen2 by -\pagetotal\ifdim\dimen0>\dimen2\vfill\penalty-10000\fi\endgroup}
    fontsize: 12pt
    linestretch: 2
    geometry: margin=1in
  typst:
    toc: true
    fontsize: 12pt
    citeproc: true
params:
  instrument_path:     ""
  data_path:           ""
  include_codebook:    true
  include_quality:     true
  include_reliability: true
  include_analysis:    true
  include_missing:     true
  include_descriptives: true
  include_models:      true
  show_code:           true
  plot_palette:        "web"
  interpretations_path: ""
  declarations_path: ""
  content_path:      ""
  provenance_path:   ""
  source_dir:        ""
  instrument_hash:     ""
  analysis_seed:       ""
  use_citations:       false
  fig_width:           ""
  fig_height:          ""
  fig_dpi:             ""
  fig_format:          ""
  quarto_found:        ""
execute:
  echo:    false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r plan}
#| output: asis
# The pre-analysis plan render_report() builds when it has no data (Session
# 10): sframe_plan_blocks() written as Markdown inside the package, so this
# template needs no surveyframe functions and both engines print the same.
content <- if (nzchar(params$content_path) && file.exists(params$content_path)) {
  readRDS(params$content_path)
}
if (is.null(content$plan_md)) {
  cat("The plan could not be read.\n")
} else {
  cat(content$plan_md, sep = "\n")
}
```
